title: Dātā (1)
text: 1-4 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca [page 251] XXXI. 4-12. 6] GANDHABBAKĀYA-SAṂYUTTA 251 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 5 Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati || tassa sutaṃ hoti Mūlagandhe adhivatthā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 6 Tassa evaṃ hoti Ahovatāham kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjeyyanti || || So dātā hoti mūlagandhānam || So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjati || || 7 Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu || pa || yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sakavyatam upapajjatīti || ||
